basics.name: Giancarlo Papa
basics.label: Senior Full Stack Engineer – Cloud Platform & AI Engineering
basics.summary: Senior Full Stack Engineer and Tech Lead with 20+ years of web development. I build and run business-critical web apps end to end — Vue.js and TypeScript SPAs, Node.js (Nuxt), Python (FastAPI) and PHP (Laravel, Symfony) services, SQL data layers on PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle — with enterprise integrations (Salesforce, CRM, LDAP), Docker and CI/CD, and cloud-agnostic deployments on Google Cloud and AWS. At Sunrise I evolved the AMP customer-care platform for 11 years and, since 2024, lead the OMNI Channel Platforms: AI research, cloudification, Salesforce DevOps and engineering standards.
basics.summaryPdf: I am a creative, self-taught Full Stack Web artisan who started writing code at the age of eleven. Web development is not just my profession, but a lifelong discipline driven by curiosity, experimentation, and a deep passion. I build and run business-critical web apps end to end: Vue.js SPAs in TypeScript, Node.js, Python and PHP services, SQL data layers (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and enterprise integrations (Salesforce, CRM, LDAP). I am especially passionate about Linux, Docker and the cloud. I take features from prototype to production with, in my head of department's words, "tremendous autonomy". Father of a beautiful child.

coreCompetencies.proof: Vue.js/TypeScript SPAs on Laravel, Node.js (Nuxt/Nitro) and Python (FastAPI) backends; AMP evolved over 11 years (2014–2025)
AI prototypes with Azure OpenAI and the Claude API; serverless on Cloud Run and AWS Lambda, Compute Engine VMs
Docker on RHEL/GCP; GitLab CI, Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, Cloud Build, GitHub Actions; Salesforce DevOps brought in-house
PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle in production: queries, transactions, views, indexes; data warehouse development
Tech Lead OMNI Channel Platforms since 2024 — architecture, engineering standards, tech-debt reduction; "tremendous autonomy" (Head of OMNI Channel)
